extra_files.description: Extra input files to copy into /io/extra for this tool smoketest.

require_progress.description: Whether the smoketest must observe progress.json during execution.

require_cluster_context.description: Whether network.csv must include at least one row with context starting with 'cluster:'.

require_unique_unordered_pairs.description: Whether network.csv must contain at most one row per unordered source/target pair.

forbid_self_loops.description: Whether network.csv must exclude rows where source == target.
